items.exampleEn: Don't waste time on trivial details.
items.exampleZh: 不要把時間浪費在瑣碎的細節上。

items.exampleEn: The class was divided on where to go for the school trip.
items.exampleZh: 全班對校外教學要去哪裡意見分歧。

items.exampleEn: The fridge is packed with food for the party.
items.exampleZh: 冰箱裡塞滿了派對要用的食物。

items.exampleEn: The modernization of farming changed village life.
items.exampleZh: 農業的現代化改變了鄉村生活。

items.exampleEn: The young writer rose to prominence after her first book.
items.exampleZh: 那位年輕作家在第一本書出版後聲名大噪。

items.exampleEn: He made himself unpopular by complaining all the time.
items.exampleZh: 他老是抱怨，讓自己很不受歡迎。

items.exampleEn: The movie's ending felt unrealistic to most viewers.
items.exampleZh: 大多數觀眾覺得那部電影的結局不切實際。

items.exampleEn: Her memory of that day was a little inaccurate.
items.exampleZh: 她對那天的記憶有點不準確。

items.sentenceEn: The concert hall was packed, and many people had to stand.
items.sentenceZh: 音樂廳擠滿了人，許多人只能站著。

items.audioEn: The weather report was inaccurate again; it said sunny, but it rained all afternoon.
items.audioZh: 天氣預報又不準了；說是晴天，結果下了一整個下午的雨。

items.sentenceEn: Opinions in the town are divided about the new parking lot.
items.sentenceZh: 鎮上對新停車場的意見很分歧。

items.sentenceEn: The library is closed for modernization until next spring.
items.sentenceZh: 圖書館正在進行現代化工程，休館到明年春天。

items.stemEn: Our goal of saving a million dollars in one month was completely ____.
items.stemZh: 我們想在一個月裡存到一百萬美元，這個目標完全不切實際。

items.stemEn: The singer's new song was ____, so radio stations stopped playing it.
items.stemZh: 那位歌手的新歌不受歡迎，所以電台不再播放。

items.passageEn: Last year, the city announced the modernization of the old central market. At first, the plan was unpopular, and people in the city were divided. Some said the old building had a place of prominence in the city's history and should not be changed. Others said the market was always packed and needed more space. In the end, the city kept the old front wall and built a modern hall behind it, with a sophisticated new payment system. Now most people agree that their worries were trivial.
items.passageZh: 去年，市政府表示要將老中央市場現代化。一開始，這項計畫不受歡迎，市民意見分歧。有些人說這棟老建築在這座城市的歷史中具有重要地位，不應該改變。另一些人則說市場總是擠滿人，需要更多空間。最後，市政府保留了舊的正面牆，在後面蓋了一座現代化的大廳，還有一套先進的新付款系統。現在大多數人都同意，他們當初的擔心其實微不足道。

questions.questionZh: 反對改建的人提出什麼理由？
options: 改建要花的費用實在太高
老建築在歷史上很重要
把整座老市場全部拆掉重蓋

items.promptZh: 這張地圖不準確，所以我們迷路了。
referenceEn: The map was inaccurate, so we got lost.
We got lost because the map was inaccurate.
rubricZh: 要用 inaccurate 當形容詞（例如 the map was inaccurate）
「迷路」可寫，例如 got lost、lost our way 等
時態合理即可（例如 was、is、got 等）

items.promptZh: 期待新員工第一週就什麼都會，是不切實際的。
referenceEn: It is unrealistic to expect new workers to know everything in their first week.
Expecting new staff to know everything in the first week is unrealistic.
rubricZh: unrealistic 表示「不切實際的」，句型例如 It is unrealistic to…、Expecting … is unrealistic 等
「新員工」可寫，例如 new workers、new staff、new employees 等
「什麼都會」可寫，例如 know everything、be able to do everything 等
